violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN (5): COOKED COD AT 49F (OVERNIGHT)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: COD DISPOSED OF DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: OBSERVED MULTIPLE SPRAY BOTTLES OF CHEMICALS WITHOUT LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: BOTTLES LABELED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: LAMB BURGER (SERVED MEDIUM), POACHED EGGS
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. CDI: PIC DREW ASTERISKS ON MENU ITEMS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE SEND ME A MENU BEFORE YOU REPRINT IT SO I CAN REVIEW FOR CONSUMER ADVISORY REQUIREMENTS.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: par cooked French fries are being held out on the cookline using time a s public health control, fries are not marked with a 4 hour end point
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. Person in charge marked fries with a 4 hour endpoint

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. Observed facility test kits had expired
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a @BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA, IODINE@ test kit. Person in charge ordered new test kits for the facility

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: EHS observed baramundi fish being thawed inside sealed ROP packaging.
violations.corrective_action: PIC disposed of fish that were thawed inside sealed ROP packaging. PIC and EHS reviewed proper thawing techniques for ROP fish with Staff.

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: EHS observed a grease deposit on the flat top grill next to the deep fat fryer.
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. PIC agreed to have flat top grill next to deep fat fryer cleaned

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: EHs observed ceiling tiles throughout the kitchen in need of repair
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC agreed to have ceiling tiles repaired and cleaned.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed that the end caps are missing from the protective light covering of fluorescent light fixtures in the kitchen area above the prep area next to the walk in cooler and cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Provide end caps to completely enclose the light bulb. PIC agreed to acquire shielding for exposed light bulbs.
